raw_text: BOOM Fact Check: A video going viral as footage of Indian special forces conducting a cross-border surgical strike is actually a scene from the 2023 Bollywood war film. Our investigation confirmed: (1) the footage matches scene timestamps from the officially released film, (2) the production house watermark is visible in the original resolution, (3) the Indian Army has not announced or confirmed any cross-border operation, and (4) professional CGI effects are clearly visible in frame-by-frame analysis.
clean_text: BOOM Fact Check confirms viral surgical strike video is from 2023 Bollywood war film. Production watermark visible. Indian Army made no such announcement. CGI effects visible in analysis.
